decisions.reason: As a small accessory with limited visible commitment beyond its own page, it is easier to discontinue than the trailer series, but its close fit with the core range still makes retention more likely than withdrawal.
This box car trailer series represents a multi-model investment and was promoted on the home page, so management is likely to stay committed and justify the launch rather than remove it quickly.

The car transporter trailer line likely required meaningful development effort, and although it was not highlighted on the home page, it is still close to the firm's core business and thus likely to be given more time.
A low-bed trailer series with home-page visibility signals both substantial sunk investment and public commitment, which under escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it on the market.
This high trailer cover series was featured on the home page and supports the firm's existing trailer offer, so management would be reluctant to reverse course after visibly backing it.
As another home-page-promoted box car trailer series with several models, it appears to be a significant strategic and commercial commitment that management would tend to continue.
